mechanism: Both drugs are associated with increased intracranial pressure and CNS effects; isotretinoin carries teratogenic risk requiring strict contraception protocols that may be affected by topiramate's enzyme-inducing properties and effects on oral contraceptive efficacy.
action: Monitor closely for signs of pseudotumor cerebri (headache, visual disturbances); ensure robust contraception in females of childbearing potential as topiramate may reduce isotretinoin contraceptive efficacy; consider alternative anticonvulsant if possible.
